title: Attio header
description: A dismissible black one-line news bar over a 68px white nav bar, pinned for the whole page: wordmark at the left edge, five medium nav links (two with chevrons) that get a grey pill on hover, an outline 'log in' and a near-black 'start' button. Over sections marked as dark bands the nav bar fades to dark. On phones a two-bar button crosses into an X and opens the links below.
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page so it stays for the whole scroll
turns dark over any element with data-header-tone="dark" (the attio dark bands carry it)
the bar spans the full window, not the framed page width
name: attio-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the brand's name: the home link's label for screen readers

props.name: logo
props.description: the wordmark (an svg, img or styled text)

props.name: announcement
props.description: the one-line news in the black bar above the nav; leave out for no bar

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: screen-reader label of the bar's close button

props.name: links
props.description: the nav links, in a row from lg and in the phone menu below

props.name: secondary
props.description: the outline button at the right end (e.g. sign in)

props.name: primary
props.description: the dark button at the right end (e.g. start free)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: labels of the phone menu button, for screen readers
